source_texts: Criar uma suíte de cenários ponta a ponta que valide invariantes financeiros de alto risco independentemente da implementação interna.
requirements.plausible_wrong_implementation: A partial or order-dependent happy-path suite misses duplicate effects, tenant leaks, retries, clock dependence, or fixture contamination.

negative_controls.failure_mode: A mutation produces a duplicated or missing financial effect.
negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: Happy-path existence checks pass despite duplicate accounting effects.
negative_controls.procedure: Execute representative financial mutations and compare immediate pre/post summary deltas.
negative_controls.expected: Each effect occurs exactly once with the expected sign.
negative_controls.observed: FIN-E2E-001/003/004/005/006 passed on the exact material head.

negative_controls.failure_mode: One or more required scenarios is absent or state leakage makes ordering matter.
negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: A partial suite passes while omitting one scenario or contaminating later tests.
negative_controls.procedure: Execute FIN-E2E-001 through FIN-E2E-009 against PostgreSQL and require scoped cleanup.
negative_controls.expected: All nine scenarios pass and cleanup prevents cross-test leakage.
negative_controls.observed: Integration API + PostgreSQL passed; all nine named invariants are present and exercised.

negative_controls.failure_mode: Sibling profile financial values leak into the selected profile.
negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: Organization-only filtering includes sibling profile rows.
negative_controls.procedure: Use deliberately distinct selected-profile and sibling-profile values, query the selected profile, and verify exclusion.
negative_controls.expected: Sibling profile value is excluded with no tenant/profile data leak.
negative_controls.observed: FIN-E2E-008 passed with a deliberately different sibling profile excluded.

negative_controls.failure_mode: Retry creates a second financial effect.
negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: State validation occurs after duplicate persistence.
negative_controls.procedure: Pay invoice, snapshot transaction identity/count/summary, retry, and compare.
negative_controls.expected: Retry is rejected without changing payment identity, linked-row count, or summary.
negative_controls.observed: FIN-E2E-009 passed on the exact material head.

negative_controls.failure_mode: Runner wall clock changes scenario periods or expectations.
negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: Tests derive financial dates from current time.
negative_controls.procedure: Inspect and execute scenarios using fixed financial date literals and immediate baselines.
negative_controls.expected: Results are deterministic independent of wall clock.
negative_controls.observed: FIN-E2E uses fixed 2040-2048 financial dates and passed on the exact material head.

negative_controls.failure_mode: A stale handoff contract crosses the producer/consumer boundary without being rejected.
negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: Hard-code a historical contract revision in the handoff builder while leaving the rest of the certificate valid.
negative_controls.procedure: Inspect and exercise the current handoff builder contract default against a legacy-version fixture.
negative_controls.expected: The producer emits the active 2026-08-20.3 contract rather than a historical revision.
negative_controls.observed: Current builder defaults to 2026-08-20.3 and focused certificate tests passed.

negative_controls.failure_mode: A stale handoff contract crosses the producer/consumer boundary without being rejected.
negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: Accept a ready certificate solely because its JSON/schema is valid without comparing the contract revision.
negative_controls.procedure: Exercise the current certificate validator with matching and obsolete contract revisions.
negative_controls.expected: Matching current contract is accepted and obsolete contract is rejected before audit expenditure.
negative_controls.observed: Current validator enforces explicit contract-version equality; focused re-audit tests passed.

risk_surfaces.reason: Financial effects must occur exactly once.
All nine scenarios and order-independent cleanup are required.
Sibling profile data must be excluded.
The handoff producer must emit the active contract revision.
The independent consumer must fail closed on a stale contract revision.
